mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT cl.cl_title AS name, cl.cl_num AS cl_num, me.me_nick AS teacherNick,t.th_picture AS cl_th_picture FROM class cl LEFT JOIN subcategory sc ON sc.sc_cl_num = cl.cl_num LEFT JOIN category ca ON sc.sc_ca_num = ca.ca_num LEFT JOIN member me ON cl.cl_tc_me_num = me.me_num LEFT JOIN thumbnail t ON cl.cl_num = t.th_cl_num WHERE cl.cl_able = 'Y' AND ( sc.sc_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR cl.cl_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR me.me_nick LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR ca.ca_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
